title: Case: Recipient reports suspicious redelivery fee message
context: A recipient has forwarded what appears to be a text message demanding a redelivery fee. The message claims to be from Plover Arc Logistics but uses an unfamiliar format and payment method. The desk must identify whether this is legitimate coordination communication or a phishing attempt, and respond appropriately.
initial_request: The recipient is uncertain whether the fee demand is real and has asked the desk to clarify.

events.body: Thank you for your message. We will respond within 24 hours. —Plover Arc Logistics Customer Support
New spring rates now available. Book freight with us for 15% off. Visit our website for details.
DL-947 (frozen fish order to Brineleaf Pantry warehouse) is on truck 4, ETA 14:15 today. No issues.

I got a text message that says I owe £8.50 for redelivery of my parcel DL-943. It tells me to pay via bank transfer to 'PAL Logistics Services' account. Is this real? I don't remember ordering a redelivery.
Stock check complete. 47 units of item SKU-2841 ready for next shipment batch.
Confirming: we do NOT send payment requests via text. Any SMS claiming a redelivery fee is not from us. We use official channels only.
Invoice PAL-2026-0847 for March services attached. Please approve for processing.
Reminder: DL-943 shows no collection fee recorded. Standard delivery completed 2026-03-14 to recipient address. No redelivery request on file.
Today's parcel volume 312 units. Afternoon collection route on time.
Return label issued for customer Keiran Walsh, ref RMA-7123. Tracking added to system.
Briefing: phishing texts impersonating us are in circulation. Anyone reporting unsolicited payment demands should be directed to ignore them and forward to us.
Can you please confirm: did Plover Arc send me that text, or is it a scam? I don't want to pay money to the wrong people.

acceptable_actions.summary: Confirm the text is not legitimate, advise not to pay, explain Plover Arc does not request fees via SMS, and direct to Safety lead contact if needed.

must: Confirm to the recipient that the text message is not a legitimate Plover Arc communication
State clearly that no redelivery fee is recorded for DL-943 and no fee is owed
Advise the recipient not to pay or respond to the suspicious text
must_not: Contact the suspicious 'PAL Logistics Services' account or acknowledge it as real
Treat the text as a legitimate redelivery fee demand or suggest the recipient pay it
Escalate to a human supervisor instead of responding directly to the recipient's straightforward question
Forward the recipient's query to Business billing or Collections control (the issue is phishing, not billing)
expected.reference_message: The text you received demanding £8.50 is not from Plover Arc Logistics. We do not request payment via SMS or text message. Your delivery DL-943 was completed on 2026-03-14 with no fee outstanding. Do not pay or reply to that message. If you receive more unsolicited texts claiming to be from us, please forward them to our Safety lead.

rationale: The desk has clear confirmation from Dispatch and Collections control that (1) Plover Arc does not send payment demands by text, (2) DL-943 has no redelivery fee on record, and (3) phishing texts impersonating the carrier are in circulation. The recipient has asked a direct yes-or-no question. The correct response is a single reassuring message to the recipient via Customer portal, confirming the text is fraudulent and advising non-payment, using only the facts already in the thread.
